objections.claim: The PD-001 external-tool grammar makes the required CLI verification path unsatisfiable. It permits git only for cat-file/rev-parse/log/ls-tree/bundle/verify-* forms, but `pylae verify` explicitly executes the existing self-weave verifier, whose closure at fc0fa05 invokes `git status --porcelain`, `git ls-files -z`, `git hash-object --no-filters`, and `git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD` (`docs/runs/clotho-self-weave/run.mjs` plus `clotho/registry.mjs`/`clotho/weavers/util.mjs`). Archive-mode `--full --bundle` also needs a defined safe way to initialize/materialize its private Git object store, yet no `git init`/equivalent form is permitted. Under the candidate's own rule, any invocation outside the grammar fails closed, so the promised clean-room full verification and blocker-3 authoritative verification cannot pass. The plan must enumerate every exact Git argv shape reachable from doctor/verify, including object-store creation, bind them to the same config/environment isolation, and add a closure-derived completeness regression proving no required invocation falls outside the grammar.
